decision_conditions: The development to which this permission relates must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of the decision notice. Reason: To comply with the provisions of S.51 of the Planning & Compulsory Purchase Act 2004.

The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the approved plans, 	Location PlanBlock Plan E100L100E101E102E103P100P101P102P103P104Flood Risk Assessment and Sustainable Drainage StrategyReason: For the avoidance of doubt and in the interests of proper planning.

All new external work shall be carried out in materials that match the existing or as specified in the approved application.Reason: To safeguard the appearance of the premises and the character of the immediate area.

The use of the property as a House in Multiple Occupation (HMO) hereby approved shall be occupied by a maximum of 6 people at any one time and shall not be subdivided or occupied as self-contained units. Reason: To accord with the stipulations of definition as a House of Multiple Occupation and to safeguard the residential character of the surrounding area.

No independent cooking or laundry facilities shall be installed in any of the respective bedrooms, and the communal kitchen and dinning/living room on the ground floor shall be retained in perpetuity.Reason: To accord with the stipulations of definition as a House of Multiple Occupation and to safeguard the residential character of the surrounding area.

The rear garden of the site must be accessible and usable at all times by all future occupiers for as long as the property remains in (HMO) use.  Reason: In the interests of the residential amenity and providing a good quality form of accommodation for future residents of the HMO in accordance with the Local Plan.

Prior to occupation of the development hereby permitted, unless otherwise agreed cycle parking should be provided in compliance with the following criteria:o	Provision of a minimum of SIX long stay cycle parking spaces: o	in an accessible location: the access route to the store should be a minimum of 1.2m wide to enable the bike too	enter the store, should be step free and involve no more than 2 doors or gates (excluding the store door) whicho	must also have a minimum opening width of 1.2mo	secured: with a British Standard mortice lock or access fobo	fully enclosed: 4 walls and a roofThe approved bicycle parking shall be provided prior to occupation and thereafter permanently retained. Reason: To ensure that sufficient provision at all times so that the development does not prejudice the free flow of traffic or the conditions of general safety along the adjacent highway, or the amenities and convenience of existing local residents.

Prior to occupation of the development hereby permitted, refuse storage facilities including facilities for the recycling of waste to satisfy the future number of occupiers on site, shall be provided within the development, in accordance with the London Borough of Enfield - Waste and Recycling Planning Storage Guidance ENV 08/162. Reason: In order to facilitate efficient, safe and clean removal of household refuse, the location and accessibility of refuse storage plus to maintain safety on the Highway.
